info.title: FLARE AI API
info.description: Evidence-first NASA PSI investigation discovery and research relevance analysis. Relevance is not fire risk; missing evidence is never inferred. Student-built prototype; not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.

post.description: Retrieves verified excerpts and returns citations linked to those excerpts. When evidence is unavailable, returns answer_status=insufficient_evidence rather than guessing. Optional scenario context uses a prior scenario analysis.

get.description: Returns imported measurement rows, never staged candidates, when linked to a verified NASA source record. Pipeline-extracted values reach this store only after explicit review. Each point retains the reported value and unit, document title, URL, available page/section, and supporting excerpt. Pending candidates are never exposed. Empty data includes catalog data_availability and an explanation; no sample values are generated.
